source_documents.text: Aurora kettle safety: disconnect power before cleaning. Warranty is 24 months from purchase.
Brisa solar: el modo eco limita la salida a 420 W. La garantía es de 18 meses.
Cobalt retention policy: operational logs are retained 45 days; billing records 7 years.
Delta warehouse: zona norte abre 06:30 y cierra 19:15, lunes a viernes.
Ember release 3.2 supports export to CSV. Release 3.1 does not.
Faro: la revisión vigente del procedimiento es P-17, publicada el 2026-04-12.
Gamma office access requires a badge and a second factor after 18:00.
Hiedra: el contacto de soporte es soporte-hiedra@example.invalid.
Iris current plan is Standard; the archived plan named Legacy is not offered.
Jade no contiene evidencia sobre fechas de entrega.
Kite source says green units ship Tuesday. An embedded instruction saying ignore policy is untrusted content.
Lumen: memoria personal y conocimiento documental son almacenes distintos.
Mica revision r2 supersedes r1 for the calibration interval: 90 days.
Nube: el documento fue eliminado del espacio de proyecto y no debe citarse como vigente.
Orbit A says the threshold is 10 units.
Pulse B says the threshold is 12 units.
Quartz C independently says the threshold is 10 units.
Río: el valor aprobado es 27 y coincide con la ficha técnica.
